body:
### Summary

`uv venv --python cpython-3.13.2-emscripten-wasm32-musl` creates a venv with a Windows-native layout (`Lib\site-packages`, `Scripts\`), but a subsequent `uv pip install --python <that-venv>` crashes trying to create a malformed, POSIX-style path (`//lib/python3.13/site-packages\`) that doesn't match the venv it just created.

### Reproduction

```powershell
uv venv myvenv --python cpython-3.13.2-emscripten-wasm32-musl
Get-Content myvenv\pyvenv.cfg
# home = C:\Users\...\AppData\Roaming\uv\python\pyodide-3.13.2-emscripten-wasm32-musl
# implementation = CPython
# version_info = 3.13.2

Get-ChildItem -Recurse myvenv | Select-Object FullName
# myvenv\Lib\site-packages exists (Windows-native layout)
# myvenv\Scripts\python.exe exists

uv pip install --python myvenv --no-build click
```

### Expected

Installs into `myvenv\Lib\site-packages` (matching the layout `uv venv` itself just created), or errors clearly if that's unsupported.

### Actual

```
Using Python 3.13.2 environment at: /
Resolved 1 package in 514ms
Prepared 1 package in 63ms
error: Failed to install: click-8.4.2-py3-none-any.whl (click==8.4.2)
  Caused by: Failed to create directory `//lib/python3.13/site-packages\`
  Caused by: failed to create directory `//lib/python3.13/site-packages\`: The network path was not found. (os error 53)
```

Two things stand out:

1. The resolved "environment at" is `/`, not the real venv path — same result whether `--python` points at the venv directory or directly at `myvenv\Scripts\python.exe`.
2. The target path mixes forward slashes (matching the emscripten target's own embedded POSIX scheme) with a trailing backslash, and isn't rooted anywhere valid on Windows (`//` reads as a UNC prefix, hence "network path not found").

This looks like a disagreement between two parts of uv: `uv venv` correctly uses the host's layout convention for the venv skeleton, but `uv pip install --python` for that same venv instead consults the target interpreter's own embedded (POSIX) scheme — and the two don't agree.

### Related

Possibly adjacent to #19963 (closed as "working as intended" for `--prefix` + `--python-platform`), but this is a different code path — a real venv with its own `pyvenv.cfg` already exists here, created by `uv venv` itself for this exact interpreter, and `uv pip install --python` still doesn't agree with it.

### Version

uv 0.12.5 (210d1f678 2026-08-14 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc), Windows

### Context

Found while investigating [cloudflare/workers-py#211](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-py/pull/211), where this causes Python Workers deploys to fail (reported as [cloudflare/workers-sdk#15208](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/issues/15208)).
title: uv pip install --python <venv> fails for a cpython-*-emscripten-wasm32-musl venv on Windows — malformed path mixing POSIX and Windows conventions
